name: bizplug-coffee-shops
description: The coffee shops & cafes plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: mobile order-ahead for pickup. It works from the business's own published profile, covering menu, hours, specials and catering orders, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
